description: Parses the AppCompatCache (ShimCache) from a SYSTEM hive, or from the live registry when no hive is given.
usage: Extracts the ShimCache (AppCompatCache) from a SYSTEM hive or the live registry, listing executables the system has seen with their last-modified times. Use it to show a file was present, bearing in mind that it does not always prove execution.
limitation: ShimCache shows the system saw a file, not that it ran. Its timestamp is the file's last-modified time, and Windows 10 and later no longer record execution flags.

parameters.label: SYSTEM hive
parameters.description: Full path to SYSTEM hive to process. If not specified, the live Registry is used (requires Administrator).

parameters.label: ControlSet
parameters.description: The ControlSet to parse. Default (-1) extracts all control sets.

parameters.label: Sort descending
parameters.description: Sorts last modified timestamps in descending order.
